_about: Place names, descriptions and shop keepers. Shop keepers are fictional.
place.grahamstown.desc: Graham's Town: brick houses and stores, the military barracks, and the market square where wagons come in from the whole frontier. The market is held every day except Sunday.
place.cradock.desc: A small town on the Great Fish River, with a church and a few stores. This is the last good place to buy supplies on the western road.
place.colesberg.desc: A frontier town at the edge of the Colony, under a flat-topped hill. Beyond it the Colony's law grows thin.
place.orange_colesberg.desc: The [[Groot Rivier]], as the trekkers call it: the Orange. Once across it, you have left the Colony.
place.philippolis.desc: A Griqua town with a mission church, gardens and grazing. Griqua horsemen ride in and out with news from all directions.
place.tarka.desc: Frontier farms in the Tarka valley, under the Winterberg. Some farms stand empty, their families already gone north.
place.stormberg.desc: Bare mountains with cold winds coming down from the heights. The road climbs and twists.
place.buffelsvlei.desc: A drift on the Orange River at the farm Buffelsvlei. Retief's people crossed here in March.
place.caledon_drift.desc: A crossing on the Caledon River, with Basotho country away to the east.
place.thaba_nchu.desc: The Black Mountain. Moroka's Barolong town spreads out below it, with the Wesleyan mission, and trekker wagons are camped all around.
place.vet_river.desc: A slow river winding across the open grassland.
place.sand_river.desc: Trekker wagons in a great laager by the Sand River, with smoke from many cooking fires.
place.vaal_drift.desc: The Vaal River, the Likwa. Beyond it lies the land Mzilikazi claimed until this year.
place.mooi_river.desc: A clear river with good grass and water. Barolong and Bahurutshe people lived here long before the wagons came.
shop.thaba_nchu_mission: The mission store at Thaba Nchu
shop.sand_river.keeper: A trekker with oxen to spare
shop.excuse.frontier_war: "Since the war, every beast on the frontier costs three times what it did."
shop.excuse.vegkop: "After Vegkop, oxen are scarce as hen's teeth. The Matabele took thousands."
shop.excuse.grain: "Grain is dear. With so many wagons going north, everyone wants meal."
